producer_report.summary: I moved stages S4 and S5 of `produce_and_verify` into the new `run/candidate.rs` as one method, `candidate_stage`. It returns `Flow::Stop` for the idle-producer failure and the admission refusal, and `Flow::Go(Admitted{commit, fingerprint})` otherwise. The driver in `mod.rs` calls it and returns `Ok(closing)` on Stop. It then runs `remove_tree`, builds `Built`, calls `write_resume_mark` and `check_and_verify`, all unchanged. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`; I ran only the 27 `run::` tests, and they pass. fmt and clippy pass, and the policy scan passes. The CHANGELOG entry names the altered statements and the caller check.
